description:
Dividend payment history for a stock, ETF or fund. Chart-ready:
    includes the current snapshot (yield %, payout ratio, frequency,
    annualised payout) plus two time series — a per-payment list
    [{ex_date, pay_date, amount, currency, yield_pct, is_special,
    is_future, is_paid, ...}] (newest first, capped at `count`; is_future
    is true while the ex-date is still ahead, for a declared payment or a
    forecast (one with a declaration_date was declared); is_paid is true
    once the pay date has passed, false before it, null when the source
    has no pay date) and an annual_totals list (oldest year first) [{year, amount,
    special_amount, payments, currency, partial}].
    Each annual_totals row sums every payment whose ex-date falls in
    that calendar year, specials included. special_amount is the part
    the source flags as special, or null when the source leaves that
    flag unset on any of the year's payments (it cannot tell which were
    special); likewise each payment's is_special is true, false, or null
    when unset. Exact duplicate rows in the source are counted once.
    partial=true marks a year that has not ended, with upcoming payments
    counted, declared or forecast. Use annual_totals for per-year totals
    and yearly bar charts; each payments row is one payment.

    All yields are emitted as percentages (4.5 = 4.5%), so plots don't
    need to know which underlying field used decimal vs. percentage
    encoding.

    Use for: "AAPL dividend history", "SPY dividend payments",
    "yield trend over 5 years", "dividend growth chart", "is the payout
    sustainable".

count.description: Number of most-recent individual payments to return (default 16, max 100). annual_totals always covers the full payment history, whatever `count` is.
count.title: Count

name: get_dividend_history
